description: Search public UDI records by at least one restrictive filter. Trade-name matching is exact, not substring or fuzzy matching. Supports riskClass (ID or English label), applicableLegislationId, nomenclatureCode (EMDN) and specialDeviceTypeId. Follows bounded nextLink paging; truncated includes page and output caps. Class/category searches find candidates, not verified certificate holders; exact=true additionally matches every supplied filter locally. Returns normalized evidence and source provenance; raw=true adds original device fields. No exhaustive-coverage or conformity guarantee.

exact.description: Apply case-insensitive trimmed equality to every supplied filter.

limit.description: Local output cap, not upstream page size.

riskClass.description: RISK_CLASS_ID number or exact English label, e.g. Class III; resolved by CODE + ID.

specialDeviceTypeId.description: SPECIAL_DEVICE_TYPE_ID; look up the software ID with eudamed_references.

tradeName.description: Exact trade name, not substring or fuzzy matching.

name: eudamed_devices
title: Search EUDAMED devices
